definitions.explanation: Used to count drops of liquid such as eye drops, medicine, or other fluids.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{滴|てき}⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧。
examples.english: Apply two drops of eye drops.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{滴|てき}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残|のこ}さず→残す：01975_nokosu⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。

examples.english: A few drops of blood had fallen.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧{滴|てき}⟦{垂|た}らした→垂らす：05339_tarasu⟧。
examples.english: I dripped a few drops of milk into the coffee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：noentry⟧、⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{滴|てき}⟦ずつ→ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me, 'Please take three drops of this medicine three times a day.'

notes:
A counter for drops of liquid. Most commonly used with medicine (especially eye drops) and in literary or formal descriptions of small amounts of liquid.

COUNTING:
- ⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{滴|てき}: 1 drop (note the っ)
- ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{滴|てき}: 2 drops
- ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{滴|てき}: 3 drops
- ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧{滴|てき}: several drops

COMMONLY COUNTED:
- ⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧: eye drops
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: liquid medicine
- ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧: blood
- ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧: sweat
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧: water

RELATED:
The standalone noun ⟦{滴|しずく}→滴：18536_shizuku⟧ (drop) uses the kun'yomi reading and is not a counter.
